description: Angular component for a navigation cards widget in the Thingsboard UI, managing display and navigation of home sections with filtering and responsive layout.

classes.name: NavigationCardsWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for navigation cards widget, handling layout, filtering, and navigation logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, setting context and settings.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Adjusts the number of columns based on container width.

methods.name: updateColumnCount
methods.description: Determines column count based on width thresholds.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Handles navigation to a specified URL within Angular zone.

methods.name: sectionPlaces
methods.description: Filters places within a section based on current filter settings.

methods.name: filterPlace
methods.description: Checks if a place passes the include/exclude filter.

methods.name: sectionColspan
methods.description: Calculates colspan for a section based on layout and number of places.
